title: Differentials of a smooth morphism of algebraic spaces are finite locally free
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For a smooth morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over a scheme S the module of relative differentials Omega_{X/Y} is finite locally free on X. The retained proof states the reduction explicitly: the assertion is etale local on X and Y by the localization lemma lemma-localize-differentials, and the etale-local case is the schemes result Morphisms, lemma-smooth-omega-finite-locally-free. Retained author proof at lines 1287-1292.
